tasks.short: Evaluate colleagues' treatment procedures and outcomes

steps.what: Review and evaluate treatment procedures and outcomes against clinical evidence and context

tasks.design: Retain clinical peer review with the psychiatrist using evidence in {DOCS}. No automatic quality score or treatment-effect judgement is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical outcomes reflect case complexity and several possible causes.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement of peer-review judgement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing appropriateness without hindsight or misleading outcome comparisons.
tasks.human_edge: Contextual clinical scrutiny and constructive professional feedback.

evidence.claim: Clinical peer review is not established as a repeated table-production task here; no saving is claimed.

assumptions: Scope is reviewing actual treatment and outcomes, without an invented administrative baseline.
Evidence is produced by care teams; the psychiatrist's retrieval and interpretation stay fully counted.
Use existing records and guidance before considering new tools.
No changed workflow means no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Current review format and evidence availability
research_questions: Does review involve any demonstrably repeated clerical work?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Clinical review retains its full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and submit agency case reports

steps.what: Verify report request, disclosure scope and source material for agency case reports
Prepare case summaries limited to the checked reporting scope and sources

loop.purpose: Compose a scoped case summary from verified clinical sources
loop.input: Checked reporting brief and agency template
loop.output: Source-linked draft with missing information marked
loop.check: Psychiatrist verifies clinical meaning, source attribution, scope and absence of unnecessary disclosures
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved material is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Clinical narrative varies and cannot be completed through fixed field merging alone

steps.what: Check exact report, recipient and disclosure authority before submitting and recording receipt

tasks.design: Use an authorised {DOCS} template and bounded drafting loop to prepare a scoped case report. The psychiatrist checks the exact content, recipient and disclosure basis before submitting through {GOV_PORTAL} or the required authorised channel.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case narratives need careful selection for a specific reporting purpose.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinician-validated documentation tools provide adjacent drafting capability.
tasks.still_hard: Determining what may and must be disclosed to a particular agency.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical and disclosure judgement remain with the psychiatrist.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber provides clinician-validated documentation; this is adjacent drafting capability and does not establish compliant agency disclosure or automatic submission.
The scoped agency-report saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Existing clinical records are produced by the separately counted record task; this task includes request-specific selection and verification.

In s1 the psychiatrist captures case identity, reporting purpose, recipient/channel, required sections, source references and disclosure decision. Capture and checks are counted at 35%; absent requirements return for manual clarification with the agency.
Test existing templates and authorised drafting features before custom code; no ready disclosure-authorised flag is assumed.
Portal submission stays manual and retains its time. A changed report or recipient voids approval.
research_questions: Can drafting reduce total preparation time after disclosure and source checks?

incremental.description: Template updates and extra quality sampling

approvals.approved_version: Exact case, report text, attachments, recipient, channel and disclosure basis; any change requires renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91, gross=9%; minus 4 focal upkeep gives net 5%. Range 0-2% allows variable agency formats and extensive corrections; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on community mental health committees

steps.what: Serve on committees and deliberate on community mental health service delivery

tasks.design: Retain committee participation and service deliberation with the psychiatrist. Existing {DOCS} holds papers; the task does not establish a separate scheduling or minute-taking baseline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service decisions involve differing needs and professional perspectives.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported reduction in deliberation is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing clinical priorities and community access.

reach.learn: How service design affects continuity of care

evidence.claim: Committee service is deliberative work; no removable clerical baseline is established here.

assumptions: Scope is service on the committee, not committee administration.
No structured community-priority score is automatically produced.
No new upkeep for unchanged participation.
research_questions: What evidence would improve committee decisions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Deliberative participation remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Clinical oversight with checked reporting assistance
reach: Coordinate report controls with records specialists
role.ambitious_version: Scoped drafts support agency reporting while clinical review and community service decisions remain human work.
